hints.title: Ternary Transformation
hints.text: Transform each element: values greater than k become +1, values less than k become -1, and k becomes 0.

hints.title: Median Condition Mapping
hints.text: In a subarray containing k, k is the median if the sum of transformed values is either 0 (odd length) or 1 (even length where k takes the lower middle position).

hints.title: Two-Sided Prefix Sum Tracking
hints.text: Find the index of k. Record frequencies of suffix sums from k to the right in a dictionary. Then iterate from k to the left and count matching right sums.

hints.title: Two-Sided Offset Prefix Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans radiating outward from the index of k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays containing k and computing median takes O(n^2 log n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space to store frequency of rightward sums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforms elements relative to k into {-1, 0, +1} and matches prefix sums across the pivot.
